answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 66 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The meadow register is checked at draw time, bridge lists the eligible set, and orchard seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 66 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The deposit is 72 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
